native_item: Compile MDL text to binary model
native_cite: mdlc/mdlc.cpp:43-79 (DoCompile loads .mdl namespace and writes a binary model file)
native_body: The MDL compiler turns a textual .mdl model definition into a binary model the engine loads.
native_rule: The MDL compiler turns textual .mdl into a binary model.
port_cite_or_reason: REPLACED: glTF import to native binary via tools/mdl-to-glb/GlbImporter.cs and MdlWriter.cs; MdlFile parses binary only (no textual MDL interpreter).
notes: Modern authoring input is GLB plus optional sidecar; native textual MDL programs are not accepted.

native_body: The compiler can optimize a model's thing-geometry for size, saving an optimized .mdl.
native_rule: The compiler can optimize thing-geometry for size.
port_cite_or_reason: tools/mdl-to-glb/MdlOptimizer.cs (binary graph; RemoveMaterial; FoldTexture; mesh/group folding to fixed point); Program.cs Optimize writes and reloads with the game MdlFile loader.
evidence: tests/Allegiance.Core.Tests/P919ModelToolsTests.cs (synthetic folds and five real corpus hulls; CLI export/import/optimize/inspect)
notes: Compiled GroupGeo serializes no names: frm-* light/frame extraction is already baked into lights/frames exports; preserve those raw exports and frame number. All LOD geometry retained; unknown constructors rejected. Text/.x ingestion is outside this binary command.

native_cite: mdlc/mdlc.cpp:153-207 (DoConvert loads an image and writes an engine texture namespace)
native_body: The tool converts a source bitmap into the engine's texture format for embedding in a model.
native_rule: The tool converts a source bitmap to the engine texture format.
port_cite_or_reason: tools/mdl-to-glb/Program.cs Import decodes embedded PNG with PngCodec and writes native texture units through MdlTextureWriter; gentexture supplies a generated source image.
notes: PNG base-colour conversion is wired through import; file row zero is mesh V=0 (P916), checked across the actual CLI path.

native_cite: mdlc/mdlc.cpp:209-262 (DoCompressAnim); 231-240 explicitly broken: ZAssert(false), null pimageFrame, CreateFrameImage commented out
native_body: The compiler can compress a sprite-sheet model animation sequence (given x/y frame grid) into the engine's compact form.
native_rule: The compiler compresses animation sequences into a compact form.
port_cite_or_reason: Native bug: animation compression cannot construct a frame image after the texture-memory change; no working native behavior to port.
notes: Excluded as bug rather than claiming a functioning native compressor or port implementation.

native_body: Models can round-trip out to a standard external format and back without losing hardpoints/mounts, lights, LODs or collision hulls.
native_rule: Models round-trip to an external format and back losslessly.
port_cite_or_reason: tools/mdl-to-glb/Program.cs export/import/verifyimport; GlbReader.cs; GlbImporter.cs; GlbWriter.cs; NativeModelAdapter.cs; SidecarDocument.cs
evidence: tests/Allegiance.Core.Tests/MdlToGlbTests.cs:Native_hull_roundtrips_through_glb; GlbToMdlTests.Native_hull_exports_to_glb_and_writes_back_with_parsed_structures_bit_exact; P919ModelToolsTests.Real_ship_cli_export_import_optimize_and_inspect_reload_in_the_game_loader; P921LodBridgeTests (synthetic and five native models; exact LOD token envelope); P921LodRenderTests (production renderer selection/pixels)
notes: P921: all authored LOD geometry/UVs/normals/textures and radii preserved in file order through named GLB parent nodes with extras; native LODGeo list/pair tokens restored. Blender 5.2.2 import/re-export preserves parents/extras; enable Custom Properties. Old exports warn with model and lost count. See docs/reports/P921_REPORT.md.

native_body: There is an interactive editor for viewing and editing MDL models.
native_rule: Interactive editor for viewing/editing MDL models.
port_cite_or_reason: REPLACED: export/edit/import GLB through external editors using tools/mdl-to-glb/Program.cs, GlbWriter.cs, GlbReader.cs and GlbImporter.cs; generated native files load in the game.
notes: mdledit is a graphical test viewer, not a general mesh editor. Replacement covers model viewing/editing via external GLB tools. Not replaced: direct .x/text-MDL ingestion, standalone image viewer, native test scenes/effect playground, native animation controls; GLB import preserves authored LODs (P921).

native_cite: mdlc/mdlc.cpp:280-300 (video settings prompt; D3D9 device; VRAM/VBIB/CVertexGenerator; EffectApp initialization)
native_body: The native compiler spins up a Direct3D9 device and effect-app context before processing models, and prompts for video settings.
native_rule: The native tool runs inside a D3D9 graphics context with video-setup prompt.
port_cite_or_reason: Win32/Direct3D9-era host scaffolding; the port model toolchain is a headless CLI with no graphics-context dependency.
